_comment: Drives test/klippy/multi_mcu_avr.test under the EMULATOR multi-bridge fan-out: one simavr bridge per dict ([mcu] + [mcu other]), both atmega2560. All steppers live on the main [mcu] so the fixture pusher routes step_trigger without MCU-prefix awareness; [mcu other] is along for the ride to validate the second bridge's identify + clock-sync path. tick_mode is OFF: the simavr tick-socket lockstep does not yet shuttle UART bytes synchronously with each RunFor (the uart_pty pump thread is wall-clock paced and races the advance, so identify never completes - see PR notes), and free-run + the clocksync non-positive-frequency guard keeps the two independent bridge clocks in sync well enough on a quiet host. auto_trsync_trigger_ticks fires the endstop after 100 step edges so G28 completes.
